text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
simplify: God is saying: do not panic. He is with you, he will hold you up, and he will give you the strength you do not have today.

text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.
simplify: The fruit of the Spirit is the character God grows in a person over time: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.
